T: Big mistake. Huge. Order the strawberries.
D: A businessman hires a woman for a week in Beverly Hills and they fall for each other.
P: Serve the strawberries and bubbles when Edward orders them up to the penthouse.
S: they bring out the flavour of the champagne
The ripest strawberries you can find, washed, dried properly and chilled, piled in a glass bowl with a tiny dish of caster sugar for dipping. A very cold bottle of bubbles alongside.
the snail that flies across the restaurant

Escargot or button mushrooms tucked into a dish, each covered with butter mashed with garlic, parsley, shallot and a splash of brandy, baked at 200C for 10 minutes until sizzling. Bread for the butter.
Blinis warmed, topped with crème fraîche, smoked salmon and dill, and cucumber cups filled with goat's cheese whipped with lemon zest and chives.
M: the dinner where she learns which fork to use
Eye fillet seasoned and seared hard, roasted at 200C to 54C, rested, with a red wine jus reduced from shallots, wine and stock, a potato gratin baked slowly in cream, and green beans.
ordering everything off the room service menu
Club sandwiches of roast chicken, crisp bacon, lettuce, tomato and mayo on three slices of toast, pinned and cut into triangles, a silver bowl of shoestring fries.
W: dessert after the night at the opera
Strawberries dried completely, dipped in tempered dark chocolate, set on baking paper, then drizzled with thin lines of melted white chocolate.
K: Champagne chilled in an ice bucket for 30 minutes, poured into flutes.

s.note: they bring out the flavour of the champagne
s.how: Wash and properly dry 500g of the ripest strawberries and chill. Pile them into a glass bowl with a tiny dish of caster sugar for dipping. Open a very cold bottle of sparkling wine alongside.

s.note: the snail that flies across the restaurant
s.how: Put 20 button mushroom caps or escargot in a baking dish. Mash 100g butter with 3 garlic cloves, parsley, a chopped shallot and a splash of brandy and cover each one. Bake at 200C for 10 minutes until sizzling. Serve with baguette.

m.note: the dinner where she learns which fork to use
m.how: Slice 1kg potatoes thin, layer with 300ml cream and garlic and bake at 160C for 75 minutes. Sear an 800g eye fillet and roast at 200C to 54C, then rest. Reduce shallots with 250ml red wine and 300ml stock for jus. Steam 300g green beans.

w.note: dessert after the night at the opera
w.how: Wash and completely dry 500g strawberries. Dip each in 200g melted dark chocolate and set on baking paper. Drizzle thin lines of 50g melted white chocolate across them and chill until set.

d.how: Chill a 750ml bottle of champagne in an ice bucket with ice and water for 30 minutes. Open gently and pour into four flutes. Big mistake not to. Huge.
